behavioral_effects: The worker no longer instantiates the codecov-slack-app notifier, so a notify for a commit runs status-patch and comment only and logs no ERROR traceback

Deployment state observed in this session, recorded here because the previous record deferred it: (a) first real CI upload on commit 88722a9, Actions run 32156446380 green; both Upload steps success against the self-hosted instance; on the instance the commit is state=complete with two uploads state=merged carrying flags backend and frontend (queried in codecov-postgres). (b) The repository is active and activated in the instance database (webhook identifier redacted 2026-08-20 for operational security) — the UI toggle that appeared off was misleading; the worker reached api.github.com (HTTP 200) using the owner OAuth token and GitHub shows commit status codecov/patch=success "Coverage not affected"; the comment notifier reported no_pull_request, as expected on a push to main. (c) The GitHub hook had been auto-created with no secret while CODECOV_GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET was empty, and both deliveries (ping, status) 403ed — the trap documented in backend/.env.example, now observed live. Fixed operationally: a strong secret generated on the host into its backend env file (value never printed; host path redacted 2026-08-20), codecov-api and codecov-worker recreated healthy, the hook config PATCHed with the same secret via the GitHub API, and both deliveries redelivered: 200 and 200, matched by two 200s in the codecov-api access log.
compatibility_impact: None for uploads, statuses, or comments: the worker yields the Slack-app notifier only when setup.slack_app is truthy, and every other notifier is gated independently. Takes effect on the host after git pull and a restart of codecov-api and codecov-worker (the file is a bind mount read at process start).

reason: Codecov's worker enables the hosted Slack-app notifier by default (setup.slack_app defaults to true) and posts to a URL no self-hosted instance has, so every notify on codecov.stikkihoney.com logged an ERROR traceback (MissingSchema: Invalid URL 'None/notify') after the first real CI upload; turning it off at the install level removes a spurious error from every future notify without touching the GitHub status and comment notifiers that do work
risks: None from this change itself. Host-side: the backend env file (and the backup copy made before editing it) carried overly permissive modes at record time; pre-existing, not tightened in this session (paths and modes redacted 2026-08-20 for operational security)
rollback: git revert and restart codecov-api/codecov-worker on the host. Nothing else to restore.
security_impact: None. One boolean in the committed, secret-free instance config; the notifier it disables would otherwise POST notification payloads to an unset URL. No credential, port, network, or exposure change.
summary: Disable the hosted Slack-app notifier in the self-hosted Codecov instance config
